identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a high-stakes, 'Stadium Night' aesthetic for a Cricket Auction Portal that feels like a live TV broadcast, not a spreadsheet.
principles: Fusion: Sports Broadcast x Fintech Dashboard
Content: The Player is the Hero; The Bid is the Action
Contrast: Deepest Blacks vs. Neon Highlights

headings.usage: Page titles, Player Names, Current Bid Amount

rules: Labels must be UPPERCASE + WIDE (tracking-widest text-xs).
Numbers (Prices/Budgets) must use tabular-nums for alignment.

strategies: Use 'Control Room' layout for Auction Panel: Player Card (Left 8 cols) + Bidding Feed (Right 4 cols).
Use 'Bento Grid' for Admin Dashboard: Stats cards mixed with list views.
Always use 'w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto' for main containers to prevent stretching on ultra-wide screens.

cards.classes: bg-slate-950/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl rounded-xl

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-lg shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.4)] transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.bid_action: bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white text-xl font-black py-4 px-8 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(34,197,94,0.6)] animate-pulse
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-medium py-2 px-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-700

inputs.classes: bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-700 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 h-12

badges.sold: bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
badges.unsold: bg-slate-500/20 text-slate-400 border border-slate-500/50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
badges.role: bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono uppercase

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture overlay to the body background (opacity 0.03) to kill the digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.lighting: Use radial gradients behind the 'Hero Player' image to create a spotlight effect.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders with 10% opacity white for all containers. Do not rely on shadows alone in dark mode.

backgrounds.usage: Login Page Background, Auction Room Backdrop (dimmed)

instructions: Animate the 'Current Bid' number when it changes (count-up effect).
Use 'AnimatePresence' for the Player Card transition when a new player comes up for auction.
Stagger the entrance of dashboard cards.

universal_guidelines: NEVER use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-950 (#020617).
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (APCA standards).
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-intensity Auction Portal. The user wants a 'Dark Theme'. Follow the 'Stadium Night' aesthetic. Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the auction page. Use Shadcn components but override their styles to match the 'glassmorphic' look defined in the 'components' section.
